description: This tool guides researchers through building a causal graph by clearly defining causes and consequences of each variable in temporal order, then generating a saturated graph containing all plausible relationships between them. The researcher deliberately removes implausible relationships one-by-one, annotating justifications as they go. This ensures that the absence of a relationship (edge) is a deliberate choice rather than a default, and nudges explicit consideration of time throughout the design and visualisation of the causal graph.
name: Open Causal Graph Builder
